headline: Warsh Reiterates Fed’s Pledge to Get Inflation Down but Doesn’t Specify How
context: Kevin M. Warsh, in his first testimony to Congress as chairman of the Federal Reserve, did not shed light on whether he supported higher interest rates to tame price pressures.
